scope: Independent static experimental-fairness/numeric-scope/file-boundary gate; mathematical coefficient/tail implementation mapping delegated separately, no duplicate proof audit.

fair_comparators.exact_streamed: Build oneHxHkernel perproxy, apply all16posteriorrows via W@S, take row quadratic forms; no kernel bank, posterior outer bank or eigendecomposition. Competent low-memory exact-formula baseline.
fair_comparators.exact_cached: OneoptionalBxHxHkernel bank, then same strong perproxy dense multiplication. Not the only exact baseline; stack/preprocessing allocation included in measured call.
fair_comparators.moment_streamed: Validation, D/tail selection, proxy-specific powers, coefficients, moments, squaring, score construction and exact fallbacks all occur inside timed call. No free prebuilt moments or kernel bank.
fair_comparators.common_prep: Exact rational finite posterior generation and all common W/rho/scale/probability arrays are timed once, then setup time added to every per-method total.
fair_comparators.posterior_storage: FullHposterior rows and allBxHprofiles remain; proxy-specific moments do not constitute one universalDdimensional code. Named common-array count omits small auxiliary state arrays and is not a complete process-memory sum.
fair_comparators.all_actions: Same unrestricted16candidateproxy set for everybranch/method. No heterogeneous budget/instrument costs are modeled here; restrictedR-firsttwo-stage score task only, not full material agent.

memory_and_timing_limits: Hand-counted algorithm_workspace_numeric_bytes is an estimate of principal arrays only: full kernel-building temporaries, stacking overlaps, power-loop vectors and allocator effects are not an exact peak accounting. README states this correctly.

Per-call tracemalloc is managed newly tracked allocations, not whole-processRSS. Previously retained result arrays and common inputs do not become a new independent method peak. No process memory superiority can follow from hand counts alone.
Oneordered timing permethod, oneBLASthread, no robust speed ranking or new acceleration claim. Both streamed and cached exact baselines retained.

Timed calls end at branch-score/tail readout. Subsequent adaptive_value, lo/hiapplication, argmax and regret diagnostics occur outside timed blocks. Do not describe reported totals as end-to-end two-stage-policy or certificate-application time.
degree_tail_and_fallback_scope: D chosen perproxy from requested epsilon1e-6/cap64; ifD>=H or bound not metwithin64, same exact perproxy algorithm is used. Fallback cost remains in moment timing; cannot silently relax epsilon to rescue speed.
Fallback tail0 means no truncation, not zero floating-point error. Code and README explicitly state this.

Numeric lo/hi are float evaluations of an ideal-arithmetic truncation bound, not directed IEEE intervals. Comparisons allow separate2e-12arithmetic tolerance; posterior/model/calibration error excluded.

Range checks reject selected power/product/square/tail/final-expectation underflow paths, but this is not universal extreme-number or cancellation robustness. No general boundary test sweep authorized.
controls_and_outcome_interpretation: Stable rationalizedH2 formula is included for symmetric1e-8 positive shape gain, so cancellation-prone full matrix is not sole correctness oracle.

Two explicit underflow paths must refuse; the first tiny-rho case may stop already at positive tail display underflow rather than uniquely proving a later feature path. Report actual refusal scope, not every guard independently tested.
Same-rho/scaledproxy control acknowledges analytic scale ordering; no pair-search gain can be claimed there.

Strict adaptive gain is computed as Emax minus maxE from the same exact-formula score grid and branch probabilities; only differences>2e-12count. Changed indices alone do not count, and no positive gap is promised before execution.
Two prior independent mathematical receipts are hashed/reused only, not rerun. D1smoke is not a second independent rational proof.

file_and_label_boundary.fixture_labels: Only exact hypothetical finite likelihood/posterior weights and deterministic correlation profiles; not real material labels.

nonblocking_required_report_wording: Score-readout time only, not end-to-end planner latency
Principal-array estimates and managed peak, not exactRSS
